status: Freeze before model inference; retrospective outcomes already known to operator, not a prospective preregistration
provenance_limit: checkpoint_release_dates conservatively use reference-repository last-modified dates, not invented training cutoffs. All reference revisions predate 2025-01-15 issuance and every scored event. OpenRouter routes do not independently attest served weight hashes or hidden provider transformations; historical interpretation is conditional on serving the named original checkpoints. No recall probe can certify absence of leakage.
budget_policy: One shared locked ledger; reserve UTF-8 message bytes plus 2048 overhead at capped input price and maximum output before each call. Retain unknown charges. Stop globally on incomplete response bodies, transport failure, 401/402/403, or budget boundary. Other failures remain missing rows; no HTTP retries, provider fallbacks, tools or search. No destructive ledger reset.
ordering: Rotate model order by event index; alternate direct/harness order by event plus model position. Fresh independent context for every row; no earlier meeting outcomes or model responses shared between rows.
comparison: Same sparse issue-date evidence and aggregate maximum output allowance; actual compute, latency and spend are not matched. Production event-preserving harness uses the registered issue date; scorer and outcome file are never loaded by inference.
baseline_rationale: 0.5 is an uninformative reference. 0.25 is a naive uniform allocation of two quarter-point cuts across eight meetings suggested approximately by the pre-issue SEP median; it is not a market probability or a calibrated policy model.
scoring: Brier and log loss on issued rows with issued coverage, all-case Brier bounds allowing missing loss [0,1], and paired complete-case harness-minus-direct Brier. No imputation or reruns. Classify YES at p>0.5, ties NO, as secondary accuracy only. Hypothetical action utility y-t when p>t, otherwise zero, t=0.25/0.5/0.75; missing rows excluded with coverage explicit. Infinite log losses preserved as the string Infinity in JSON.
uncertainty: Eight correlated scheduled decisions from one policy year; no independent-cluster confidence interval, significance claim, calibration guarantee, model leaderboard placement or 9/10 general-decision rating. Known-outcome retrospective study and operator-selected year remain limitations. Do not tune on these rows then call them holdout.
ai_disclosure: AI-assisted protocol, source extraction, code and analysis; no independent human endorsement.
